description: Hand-written retrieval cases: an employee question and the document IDs that answer it. Where the knowledge base holds near-duplicate entries, every equally correct entry is listed. 'handbook' cases target the synthetic BuzzTech content, 'it' cases target IT ticket resolutions, 'compliance' cases target the cleaned HR compliance entries.
